line: A cut-away model of Futian Station on a thin display plinth: the street, metro and high-speed tiers lift apart, a bus, a metro and a bullet train pull in, and the real towers behind light up as day turns to night.
line_cn: 一块切开的福田站模型放在薄底座上：地面、地铁、高铁三层被抬开，公交、地铁和高铁一辆辆进站，天黑时后面真实的高楼一批批亮起窗来。
uses: Stations, hubs and buildings shown in section
A place or a project as an architectural model
How the layers of a city connect, from the street down
